## What 1c does NOT show (PREREG §5, verbatim pointers)

- F is FIFO-world LOO Delta: demand under FIFO's memory, not under any scorer's own memory.
- Agreement at the top or bottom is not eviction quality; no scorer is deployed here.
- One corpus, one width, in-sample in documents (U is already inspected); no claim about real models.
- The psi rows are descriptive; offline-psi and LS were fit on U-train.
